metadata.label: Number of persons received for settlement by year of reception, region of reception (Rec), region of residence (Res), sex and age. Year 2024-2025
note:
Refugees assigned to a municipality
Persons received by a municipality for settlement refers to persons who were granted a residence permit as a refugee or as a person granted subsidiary protection, according to certain provisions in the Aliens Act (2005:716), and their families, and who are covered by the Ordinance on state compensation for measures for certain aliens (2010:1122).

Information on the year of reception by a municipality is available as from 1997. 
Up to 2016, a person was presumed to be assigned to a municipality if the person’s grounds for residency (GFB) was as a family member of a refugee/person eligible for subsidiary protection/ compassionate grounds/permit under a temporary law or other permit, refugees
The statistics are presented according to the regional division as of January 1 of the following year.

Reception region refers to the region where the person was first received for settlement. It may differ from the region of residence as of 31 December each year, which refers to the region where the person resides during the reference year.
Information on the receiving municipality and receiving county  is available for both the current year (t) and the previous year (t–1) up to and including 2021.
